ownership.dita_source: documentation/src/dita is hand-authored source and is never copied into the delivery root
ownership.generator: BPM093-M14-08 documentation generator is the only writer of PDFs and delivery metadata
ownership.promotion: BPM093-M14-09 verifies a complete temporary release directory and atomically promotes it to distributions/documentation/{bpm_version}
ownership.removal: Remove a promoted release directory only through an explicit maintainer-approved release-retirement operation; never use broad cleanup against distributions or data/ai

integrity.manifest: records BPM version, generator identity, source revision, locale-guide inventory and each PDF SHA-256
integrity.checksums: checksums.sha256 contains SHA-256 records for every declared PDF and delivery metadata file
integrity.notice: NOTICE.txt records generated-artifact ownership, source provenance and rebuild command
integrity.rebuild: A rebuild creates a sibling temporary directory, validates the exact declared set and checksums, then atomically replaces only the matching version directory

current_release_boundary: BPM093-M14-07 defines the delivery layout. BPM093-M14-08 generates the PDFs and BPM093-M14-09 atomically promotes the verified release directory. The tracked tree retains only released source-controlled delivery history; the current handoff target is generated, verified and intentionally ignored.
